question: Who among the following has been awarded the Bharathi award 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Seeni Viswanathan**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Seeni Viswanathan**__ was a noted writer in India.

 __
 
• He was conferred with the **2020 Bharathi Award.**
 
• He is credited with compiling the voluminous works of Bharathi in chronological order.
 
 
 
• Since 1994, the Bharathi Award has been given to prominent individuals who have rendered outstanding service in any sector of social importance.
 
• The occasion commemorates Tamil poet and writer** Mahakavi Subramanya Bharati's** 138th birthday (December 11, 2020).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Raj Kamal **was a famous Indian composer. 

 
 
• B.R. Chopra's legendary television show Mahabharat's music was composed by him.
 
 
 
• **Vidyut Mohan **is the co-founder and CEO of Takachar.
 
• **Kaniyan Poongunranar **was an influential Tamil philosopher from the Sangam age.
